# Wildfire Leadership

> Wildfire Leadership (Wildfire Leadership, LLC), based in Charleston, South Carolina and founded by Bill and Stephanie Lammers, helps individuals, families, and organizations uncover purpose and unleash potential. Its two visual tools are the Mission Portrait™ and the 7 Igniters™. It also offers leadership coaching, workshops, keynote speaking, facilitator certification, and curriculum licensing.

- Founders: Bill Lammers, Founder & CEO (entrepreneur, author, and leadership coach with over 25 years of experience; certified John Maxwell coach; Patrick Lencioni CapaPro member; author of Flip the Script). Stephanie Lammers, Co-Founder (keynote speaker, author, and executive coach; over 20 years in healthcare and human relations; author of Discovering Joy in Your Lane). Tiffany Rodriguez is Operations & Administrative Director.
- Who it serves: K-12 schools, colleges and universities, businesses and organizations, churches, nonprofits, and community organizations, and individuals, couples, and families. The curriculum comes in faith-based and non-faith-based versions.
- Reach: more than 50,000 Mission Portraits completed, more than 70 certified facilitators, and a presence in 32 states and 13 countries.
- Prices stated on the site: the Mission Portrait™ and the 7 Igniters™ are each $35 self-guided, or $299 for a 60-minute virtual session with a Certified Facilitator. Coaching, workshops, keynotes, certification, and licensing are priced on request.
- Based in: Charleston, South Carolina. Facilitated Mission Portrait™ and 7 Igniters™ sessions are 60-minute virtual sessions.
- Company: Wildfire Leadership, LLC, a company (not a charity). 10% of all proceeds support Ignite Academy, a 501(c)(3) founded by Bill and Stephanie Lammers that equips students who lack direction with purpose, character, and workforce skills.
- Contact: info@wildfireleadership.com, the contact form at https://www.wildfireleadership.com/contact/, or Instagram @wildfireleadership. We respond within 24 business hours.

## What we offer

- [Leadership Coaching](https://www.wildfireleadership.com/leadership-coaching/): leadership coaching for executives and leadership teams, school and college leaders, church and ministry leaders, and individuals and couples; 1-on-1 executive coaching and leadership cohorts of up to 10 leaders; pricing on request
- [Workshops & Keynote Speaking](https://www.wildfireleadership.com/workshops/): leadership workshops (Working Genius, The Advantage, DISC and more), individual and couples Mission Portrait™ coaching, Family Mission Portrait™ workshops, keynotes
- [Facilitator Certification](https://www.wildfireleadership.com/facilitators/): 90-minute training to certify in the Mission Portrait™, the 7 Igniters™, and assessments
- [Resources](https://www.wildfireleadership.com/resources/): books by Bill and Stephanie Lammers (Flip the Script, Discovering Joy in Your Lane, Wildfire Daily Journal) and the fts. app

## Tools

- [Mission Portrait™](https://www.wildfireleadership.com/mission-portrait/): Mission Portrait by Wildfire Leadership, a one-page visual guide to your core values, vision, and mission ($35 self-guided, about an hour; $299 for a 60-minute facilitated session)
- [The 7 Igniters™](https://www.wildfireleadership.com/7-igniters/): seven stages that turn a Mission Portrait™ into an action plan ($35 self-guided, $299 facilitated)
- [Marriage & Family Mission Portrait™](https://www.wildfireleadership.com/family-mission-portrait/): a 2-hour workshop for couples and families

## Who we serve

- [Education](https://www.wildfireleadership.com/education/): Ignite Students K-12 and Ignite Higher Ed
- [Ignite Students K-12](https://www.wildfireleadership.com/education/k-12/): curriculum, teacher certification, and a district case study (Northeastern Local Schools)
- [Ignite Higher Ed](https://www.wildfireleadership.com/education/higher-ed/): case studies from Northwest State Community College and Hocking College
- [Business & Organizations](https://www.wildfireleadership.com/business/): leadership coaching, workshops, and licensing; Flatrock Bridge Group and Keller Logistics case studies
- [Faith & Community](https://www.wildfireleadership.com/faith-community/): faith-based curriculum, team coaching, and INVEST Marriage for churches and nonprofits
